original_excerpt: This study examines the interrelationships among self-efficacy, engagement, attitudes, behavioral intentions, and perceived learning in secondary STEM education. … The study was based on real-world classroom teaching involving 710 students, who engaged with an AI learning companion that provided personalized guidance and support during STEM laboratory courses. … Using a single-group, post-test-only design and partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM), the study examined concurrent associations among students' self-reported perceptions. … These findings describe concurrent associations and do not establish that changes in learning are attributable to the AI learning companion.
interpretation_note: 轉述作者摘要的研究問題、樣本、設計與作者自述限制；各路徑係數與排序依規則不寫入。
scope_limitation: 同儕審查期刊論文（Frontiers in Education，監測清單 J29）；希臘、葡萄牙、西班牙的中學一年級學生 710 人（12–13 歲）的單組後測自陳資料；研究經費來自歐盟 Horizon 計畫。

summary_evidence_spans: This study examines the interrelationships among self-efficacy, engagement, attitudes, behavioral intentions, and perceived learning in secondary STEM education.
The study was based on real-world classroom teaching involving 710 students, who engaged with an AI learning companion that provided personalized guidance and support during STEM laboratory courses.
Using a single-group, post-test-only design and partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM), the study examined concurrent associations among students' self-reported perceptions.
These findings describe concurrent associations and do not establish that changes in learning are attributable to the AI learning companion.

claim_text: 來源機構：Frontiers in Education；資料標題：Toward calibrated AI readiness in K–12 school-based practice: the roles of AI-related epistemic vigilance capacity and governance clarity；來源刊登日：2026-11-06。作者摘要報告：兩階段研究檢視「經校準的 AI 準備度」，即自陳準備好查證 AI 產出、辨識倫理界線，並對 AI 輔助的專業決定保有責任；第一階段 425 名學校專業人員填答 AI 相關知識警覺能力、自主調節動機、治理明確度與上述準備度的問卷；第二階段 25 名學校心理師與輔導人員參加一個月的線上試行培訓；作者寫明第一階段為橫斷面、第二階段無對照組，結果不能確立效應。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）
source_title: Toward calibrated AI readiness in K–12 school-based practice: the roles of AI-related epistemic vigilance capacity and governance clarity
title_zh: 邁向 K–12 學校實務中經校準的 AI 準備度：AI 相關知識警覺能力與治理明確度的角色
source_locator: 出版社文章頁（frontiersin.org，2026-11-07 讀取 200）：Published 06 November 2026；摘要歸屬：Abstract 第 2、3、6 句與末句
original_excerpt: This two-phase study examined calibrated AI readiness, defined as self-reported readiness to verify AI outputs, recognize ethical boundaries, and retain responsibility for AI-assisted professional decisions. … In Phase 1, 425 school-based professionals completed a survey assessing AI-related epistemic vigilance capacity, autonomous regulatory motivation, governance clarity, and calibrated AI readiness. … In Phase 2, 25 school psychologists and school counselors participated in a one-month online pilot training program delivered through Moodle and Zoom. … Because Phase 1 was cross-sectional and Phase 2 lacked a comparison group, the results do not establish causal effects.
interpretation_note: 轉述作者摘要的概念定義、兩階段設計、樣本與作者自述限制；第一階段的路徑係數與第二階段前後測的描述性變化依規則不寫入。
scope_limitation: 同儕審查期刊論文（Frontiers in Education，監測清單 J29）；對象為在 K–12 學校服務的學校心理師、輔導人員、督導、教師與特教人員等學校專業人員，第一階段各職別人數未見；第二階段為學校心理師 15 人、輔導人員 10 人的無對照組試行培訓。
ai_crosscheck_record: 第一輪 2026-11-07 子代理以監測期刊 ISSN 查詢列出並讀出版社頁；本 session 擇摘要第 2、3、6 句與末句撰寫中文摘要與中文譯名，不寫係數與前後測變化；第二輪 2026-11-07 由隔離子代理逐句對照原文與 3.2.1 節、表 2，判定需修改，依建議補回構念的限定語、刪去「據此」，範圍說明補第二階段職別人數，對象同意記其他教育關係人，修正後一致。同一模型，非獨立審閱。
ai_lit_note: 對象為其他教育關係人：學校專業人員查證 AI 產出、辨識倫理界線與保有決策責任的準備度，屬 AI 素養（A），對應 T-ETH「深化AI安全負責應用」、T-BAS「執行監督以檢核AI產出」
summary_evidence_spans: This two-phase study examined calibrated AI readiness, defined as self-reported readiness to verify AI outputs, recognize ethical boundaries, and retain responsibility for AI-assisted professional decisions.
In Phase 1, 425 school-based professionals completed a survey assessing AI-related epistemic vigilance capacity, autonomous regulatory motivation, governance clarity, and calibrated AI readiness.
In Phase 2, 25 school psychologists and school counselors participated in a one-month online pilot training program delivered through Moodle and Zoom.
Because Phase 1 was cross-sectional and Phase 2 lacked a comparison group, the results do not establish causal effects.
attributed_summary: 兩階段研究檢視「經校準的 AI 準備度」，即自陳準備好查證 AI 產出、辨識倫理界線，並對 AI 輔助的專業決定保有責任；第一階段 425 名學校專業人員填答 AI 相關知識警覺能力、自主調節動機、治理明確度與上述準備度的問卷；第二階段 25 名學校心理師與輔導人員參加一個月的線上試行培訓；作者寫明第一階段為橫斷面、第二階段無對照組，結果不能確立效應。
